title: A connection between low-lying zeros and central values of $L$-functions
summary: We discuss the relation between statistics on low-lying zeros of $L$-functions and distribution of the associated central values. More precisely, we deduce explicit conditional lower bounds toward the Keating-Snaith conjecture (on the distribution of central values of families of $L$-functions) from partial results toward the Rudnick-Sarnak density conjecture (on the one-level density for the low-lying zeros of these $L$-functions).
